DPWH Manual · Figure 11 Reference

§1.9.3, p.16 refers to Figure 11 for subbase thickness. It shows the same 80/150 mm minimum branches and the below-CBR-2% addition used by the RN29 tool. Material suitability and project requirements remain separate checks.

Scope and limitations
  • Figure 6 provides structural sub-base thickness only.
  • No extrapolation is permitted outside the supported chart domain.
  • Frost, total pavement depth, material suitability, and local requirements remain separate checks.
  • The model status is VALIDATED_WITH_LIMITATIONS; no professional certification is implied.
